title: fix(triage): keep author-controlled text inside code in comments
body:
Closes [CL-XXXX](https://linear.app/abklabs/issue/CL-XXXX)

## What changed
- Author-controlled text in Triage comments (failing check names, file paths, rule evidence) is flattened to one line, stripped of control and invisible characters, capped at 200 characters and wrapped in a code span whose fence is longer than any backtick run inside, so it cannot render outside code.
- The paths-together rule now puts the changed paths in its evidence instead of its reason.

## Verification
- New render test feeds evidence with blank lines, CRLF, line separators, HTML comments, backtick runs, bidi and control characters, mentions, links and images; it fails before and passes after.
- `bun run check`, `bun run test` (691 pass).
